title: Scaffolding — generation refused while mandatory cards are empty
user_message: I need to write a budget request for more tooling spend next quarter.

cards.Scene: The data team runs its nightly pipeline on a single self-managed scheduler that I maintain alongside my normal work.
cards.Conflict: The scheduler failed three times last quarter and each failure cost a full day of analyst time while I restored it by hand.
cards.Value: Analysts stop losing days to pipeline recovery and I stop being the single point of failure for the nightly run.
